production.releaseDecision: 2.6.0 code was finalized in 05a459d after the mobile search follow-up; Vercel Git integration reported success, and the canonical production site was rechecked in Chrome after the final deployment.

implementation: The homepage, product hub, six collection pages, contact page, account pages and PDP now share a compact type scale, restrained spacing, consistent CTA treatment and enquiry-led B2B copy.

Collection pages use a real product grid and shared ProductCard with working product links, favourites and product-specific enquiry links; standalone pipe separators and internal review language are removed from public copy.

The accepted lace source record had mixed white and black reference media. Public catalogue mapping now publishes the black reference set for that style and suppresses the conflicting finger-style field until the supplier confirms one colourway.
The RFQ query defaults now hydrate consistently, preserving family and product references without a React hydration error.
Supabase REST reads now retry one safe GET after a transient TLS/socket failure and return a user-safe error result instead of exposing a Next.js runtime overlay.
Account API reads are scoped to the verified customer id/email; the new alias account can sign in, save profile details and view only its own enquiry/quote records.

Admin operation feedback is Chinese in the dashboard, product, variant and quote forms; the product editor maps internal finger-style and age values to Chinese labels while preserving stored enums; unauthenticated admin access remains protected.
